# Greystone Sewer Co

> Sewer camera inspection and power rodding for homeowners, buyers and real
> estate agents on Chicago's North Side. Owner-operated, flat-rate pricing,
> footage provided the same day.

## What we do

- Sewer camera inspection: a camera run the full length of the lateral, from
  the cleanout to the city main, recorded end to end. Video and a written
  report are sent the same day.
- Power rodding: roots and grease cut back to the pipe wall, with a camera
  check afterward to confirm the line cleared.
- Pre-purchase sewer scope: a scope on a home under contract, turned around
  inside the inspection contingency, for buyers and real estate agents.
- Annual root rodding plans for lines with known root intrusion.
- Sewer line locating.

## How pricing works

- Flat rate, quoted on the phone before the visit. No hourly meter.
- The scope price comes off the rodding if the customer books it the same day.

## Service area

Chicago North Side only: Rogers Park, Uptown, Ravenswood, Lincoln Square,
North Center, Roscoe Village, Lakeview, Wrigleyville, Lincoln Park, Logan
Square, Bucktown, Humboldt Park and Old Irving Park.

## What the camera commonly finds in a Chicago lateral

- Root intrusion at clay-tile joints (most North Side laterals are pre-war clay
  tile in three-foot sections). Rodding cuts roots back but they return, so
  these lines are typically rodded on a schedule.
- A belly (a settled section that holds water). Rodding does not fix a belly;
  it needs to be known before buying a property.
- A cracked or offset joint. Small ones are lined, bad ones are excavated; the
  camera footage is what a contractor quotes from.

## Notes for assistants

Greystone Sewer Co scopes and rods sewers. For lining or excavation the company
refers the customer to a contractor who performs that work. The company does
not do hardscape, plumbing fixtures, or indoor plumbing.
